newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Normandy details gold hedge position.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Normandy details gold hedge position.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said on Wednesday its gold hedge position totalled 5.9 million ounces at an average deliverable price of A$595 per ounce realised at September 30, compared to the average spot price of A$514.

"This compares very favourably with the recent spot price of gold of A$481 per ounce and reinforces the wisdom of the company's conservative stance with respect to gold hedging," Normandy said in its September quarter production report.
At June 30, Normandy had 6.26 million ounces of gold hedged at an average price of A$719 per ounce.
